title: The institutional opportunity
lead: Rugby is an institutional decision before it is an athletic one. Here is what it can do for a college or university.

pillars.title: Enrollment
pillars.body: A new population of prospective student-athletes a college or university can actively recruit.

pillars.title: Cost
pillars.body: A low-cost program that shares existing fields and needs little capital.

pillars.title: Athletics
pillars.body: A varsity offering that expands the institution's athletic portfolio.

pillars.title: Differentiation
pillars.body: Another way to stand out in competitive recruiting markets.

pillars.title: Student experience
pillars.body: Another structured community and competitive opportunity for students.
